panel.title: Beszel Desktop

ctl_path.description: Path to the beszel-ctl binary (falls back to ~/.local/bin/beszel-ctl when omitted from PATH).
ctl_path.label: beszel-ctl binary

danger_threshold.description: Highlight CPU, memory, GPU, disk, and core bars in error color at or above this percentage.
danger_threshold.label: Danger threshold (%)

network_mode.description: How to display live network throughput in this bar widget (auto-hides if the host does not report network stats).
network_mode.label: Network throughput

notify_alerts.description: Send a desktop notification when a Beszel hub alert triggers on a monitored host.
notify_alerts.label: Alert notifications

show_containers.description: Show the top Docker/Podman containers by CPU usage (auto-hides on hosts without containers).
show_containers.label: Containers

show_cores.description: Show the live per-core CPU utilization heatmap.
show_cores.label: Per-core CPU heatmap

show_disk.description: Show root disk usage, live read/write throughput, and degraded storage pool alerts.
show_disk.label: Disk & storage

show_gpu.description: Show live GPU utilization sparkline, VRAM usage, and power draw (auto-hides on hosts without a GPU).
show_gpu.label: GPU

show_load.description: Show 1/5/15-minute load averages (with core count context) in the vitals strip.
show_load.label: Load average

show_network.description: Show live download and upload throughput rates with a dual-series sparkline.
show_network.label: Network I/O

show_swap.description: Show swap usage under the memory sparkline whenever swap is in use.
show_swap.label: Swap usage

show_vitals.description: Show the compact vitals strip (uptime, peak temperature, and battery).
show_vitals.label: Vitals strip

show_cpu.description: Show live CPU utilization percentage in this bar widget.
show_cpu.label: Show CPU

show_disk.description: Show root disk usage percentage in this bar widget.
show_disk.label: Show disk

show_gpu.description: Show primary GPU utilization percentage in this bar widget (auto-hides when no GPU is reported).
show_gpu.label: Show GPU

show_host_name.description: Show the Beszel host name next to the metrics in this bar widget.
show_host_name.label: Show host name

show_memory.description: Show live memory utilization percentage in this bar widget.
show_memory.label: Show memory

show_temp.description: Show peak sensor temperature in this bar widget (auto-hides when no temperature sensors are reported).
show_temp.label: Show temperature

socket_path.description: Optional override for the beszel-relay Unix socket path. Leave empty for $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/beszel-relay.sock.
socket_path.label: Relay socket path

stale_seconds.description: Mark live metrics stale when no sample arrives within this many seconds.
stale_seconds.label: Stale threshold (seconds)

system.description: Beszel host to show in this bar widget (leave empty for the first available host).
system.label: Host

warn_threshold.description: Highlight CPU, memory, GPU, disk, and core bars in warning color at or above this percentage.
warn_threshold.label: Warning threshold (%)
